turns.speaker: Dr Neri Solan
turns.text: The tube study shows both tubes are open. Taken with ovulation evidence and the semen assessment this supports unexplained infertility.

turns.speaker: Maya Chen
turns.text: Does that mean something was missed?

turns.speaker: Dr Neri Solan
turns.text: It means the standard assessment has not found an explanation. It does not prove every possible condition is absent.

turns.speaker: Maya Chen
turns.text: Can we discuss IVF as well as insemination?

turns.speaker: Dr Neri Solan
turns.text: Yes. A usual first treatment is several cycles of oral stimulation with IUI. We can also discuss IVF costs and risks.

turns.speaker: Maya Chen
turns.text: After that discussion we would prefer IVF. I understand it might not work.
